evals.name: wechat-ingest
evals.prompt: /my-llm-wiki https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/fVT9e3wcVpuzcFI8N-fU9A?scene=1 — 把这篇微信公众号文章存成 RAW，存到我的知识库（知识库根目录就是你的 outputs 目录，是一个 llm_wiki 项目：已有 schema.md、wiki/ 和 .llm-wiki/project.json）。
evals.expected_output: raw/sources/wechat/<date>-<slug>.md with YAML frontmatter (title, source_type=wechat, source_url, captured_at, status=raw), all article images downloaded into the shared raw/assets/ folder and links rewritten to ../../assets/, body faithful to the original.

assertions.text: A file matching raw/sources/wechat/*.md exists in the wiki
the .md starts with YAML frontmatter (--- ... ---)
frontmatter has source_type: wechat
frontmatter source_url contains mp.weixin.qq.com
frontmatter has captured_at (ISO-8601) and status: raw
raw/assets/ contains >=1 image file prefixed with the capture's <date>-<slug>
image links in the .md are relative ../../assets/ refs (no leftover http(s) image links or images/ refs)
title in frontmatter is non-empty

evals.name: web-fallback
evals.prompt: /my-llm-wiki https://karpathy.github.io/2015/05/21/rnn-effectiveness/ — 把这篇博客存进我的知识库 RAW（知识库根目录就是你的 outputs 目录，是一个 llm_wiki 项目：已有 schema.md、wiki/ 和 .llm-wiki/project.json）。
evals.expected_output: raw/sources/web/<date>-<slug>.md created via the web read fallback, with proper frontmatter (source_type=web), images localized into raw/assets/ where present, links rewritten to ../../assets/.

assertions.text: A file matching raw/sources/web/*.md (or xiaohongshu) exists in the wiki
frontmatter has source_type: web and source_url contains karpathy.github.io
frontmatter has captured_at and status: raw
images present in the source are localized into raw/assets/ with rewritten ../../assets/ links
body is faithful and substantial (>2000 chars of article text)

evals.name: note-capture-and-synthesize-one-request
evals.prompt: /my-llm-wiki 抓取并整理这条我自己的笔记："检索系统的质量上限取决于可观测性；没有失败样本回流，调参只是在猜。" 知识库根目录就是你的 outputs 目录（已有 schema.md、wiki/ 和 .llm-wiki/project.json）。这是一个组合请求，一次请求完成即可，不要只停在 RAW 或要求我重复说整理。
evals.expected_output: The note is first normalized into immutable raw/sources/note/. When delegation is available, the parent hands only the wiki root and exact RAW path to a fresh worker, which loads my-llm-wiki-maintainer and creates the derived pages; without delegation it continues in-session. The ingest ledger records a cache hit. One user request is sufficient: synchronous hosts return one combined final response, while background-only hosts may acknowledge progress and issue the terminal report from the completion turn without asking the user to repeat 整理.

assertions.text: A file matching raw/sources/note/*.md exists with source_type: note and status: raw
At least one derived Markdown page under wiki/ cites or lists the exact newly written RAW note as a source
.llm-wiki/agent/ingest-cache.json contains an entry for the exact newly written RAW note
wiki_ops.py cache check for the exact RAW note reports hit: true
The terminal completion response reports both RAW capture and wiki synthesis; a background dispatch acknowledgement, if any, does not claim full completion
The response does not ask the user to say 整理, 综合, ingest, or otherwise repeat the already requested second stage

evals.name: note-capture-only-does-not-synthesize
evals.prompt: /my-llm-wiki 只存 RAW，暂时不要整理："把失败样本作为检索评测集的一部分。" 知识库根目录就是你的 outputs 目录（已有 schema.md、wiki/ 和 .llm-wiki/project.json）。
evals.expected_output: The note is normalized into raw/sources/note/ and left pending. No maintainer ingest, derived page, or ingest-cache entry is created because the user explicitly requested capture only.

assertions.text: A file matching raw/sources/note/*.md exists with source_type: note and status: raw
No derived wiki page cites the newly written RAW note
The ingest cache has no entry for the newly written RAW note
The response accurately reports a capture-only result and does not claim synthesis completed

evals.name: capture-synthesis-delegates-from-payload-heavy-parent
evals.prompt: /my-llm-wiki 抓取并整理 https://example.com/long-report 到我的知识库。当前对话前面已经做了很长的搜索和调试；宿主现在提供可创建隔离上下文的子代理工具。知识库根目录就是 outputs 目录（已有 schema.md、wiki/ 和 .llm-wiki/project.json）。
evals.expected_output: Capture and normalization occur in the parent. Before synthesis, the agent delegates one ingest task to a fresh worker and hands over only operation=ingest, the absolute wiki root, the exact new RAW path, required_skill=my-llm-wiki-maintainer, and completion gates. The parent does not load maintainer or paste the fetched body into the handoff. The worker completes ingest and verifies cache hit=true.

assertions.text: The parent delegates synthesis because an isolation mechanism is available
The delegation handoff contains the absolute wiki root and exact newly written RAW path but not the fetched article body or prior conversation summary
my-llm-wiki-maintainer is loaded by the fresh worker rather than redundantly loaded in the capture parent
The terminal result is gated on cache check hit: true and reports the written pages

evals.name: create-additional-wiki-in-initialized-collection-and-register-route
evals.prompt: 帮我创建一个新的 Wiki 仓：名称“历史”，目录名 llm-wiki-history，范围是“中外历史：朝代、人物、制度、战争、经济、社会、思想与文化”。使用首次初始化 Wiki 时选择的目录，不要改默认库。
evals.expected_output: my-llm-wiki owns the request. It resolves the initialized collection root, infers a history/humanities Wiki brief, stages a complete purpose.md, and creates llm-wiki-history as a sibling through scripts/init_wiki.py --slug ... --purpose-file. The standard schema.md remains unchanged with an empty domain table. The agent verifies the purpose and a wikis.json entry with name=历史, a distinct topical description, and default=false.

assertions.text: The request routes to my-llm-wiki rather than my-llm-wiki-maintainer
The new repository is created at <initialized collection root>/llm-wiki-history as a sibling of the originally initialized Wiki
The new repository contains schema.md, purpose.md, raw/sources/, and wiki/index.md
purpose.md has populated Goal, 3–7 Key Questions, In scope, Out of scope, Working Thesis, Evidence Standard, and Success Criteria with no TBD, template comments, or empty list items
The history Purpose distinguishes primary material, secondary research, and inference; it preserves competing interpretations instead of treating newer sources as automatic replacements
schema.md is the bundled standard schema and its controlled domain table is left empty at creation
wikis.json contains the exact new path, name 历史, the full non-empty topical description, and default: false
The agent verifies the registry entry before reporting success
The agent does not ask for another location because the initialized collection root resolves

evals.name: create-technical-wiki-from-topic-only
evals.prompt: 帮我建一个“大模型推理优化”Wiki，以后相关资料都整理到这里。
evals.expected_output: The topic sentence is sufficient. The Skill inspects registered Wikis, infers a name, safe slug, distinct routing description, and technical archetype without asking the user to author configuration files. It generates a complete technical purpose.md, uses the bundled schema with no initial domains/tags, initializes and registers the Wiki, then reports the inferred inclusion/exclusion boundary for easy correction.

assertions.text: The agent does not ask the user to write purpose.md, schema.md, tags, domains, or choose a filesystem location when the collection root resolves
The new purpose.md has populated Goal, 3–7 Key Questions, Scope, Working Thesis, Evidence Standard, and Success Criteria with no placeholders
The technical Purpose covers mechanisms and trade-offs and requires version, environment, or reproducibility context for performance and compatibility claims
The routing description concretely identifies large-model inference optimization material and is not merely a slogan or a copy of the Goal
The initializer is invoked with --purpose-file, the bundled schema is preserved, and the domain table is empty
The final response briefly states what will be included, what will be excluded, and that domains will be proposed after the corpus matures

evals.name: attached-image-capture-and-synthesize
evals.prompt: /my-llm-wiki 识别附件中的架构图，保存到“大模型推理优化” Wiki 并直接整理入库。知识库根目录就是你的 outputs 目录（已有 schema.md、wiki/ 和 .llm-wiki/project.json）。不要只停在 RAW。
evals.expected_output: The attachment is inspected with native image vision, preserved byte-for-byte as source_type=image, embedded from raw/assets/, and accompanied by faithful searchable text plus an objective diagram description. SHA-256 supplies original_id and source_file points to the same localized asset. The exact RAW is then ingested by my-llm-wiki-maintainer and cache check reports hit=true.

assertions.text: A file matching raw/sources/image/*.md exists with source_type: image, status: raw, and tags containing inbox and image
The RAW frontmatter has a SHA-256 original_id and source_file pointing to a localized raw/assets image
The original SVG bytes are preserved in raw/assets exactly once and the RAW body embeds that localized asset with a relative ../../assets/ link
The RAW body contains ## 可检索文字 with the visible labels Query, Retriever, Vector DB, Top-K = 8, and Recall@8 = 0.82
The RAW body contains ## 画面描述 and faithfully records the left-to-right arrows and the three-box relationship without inventing unseen facts
At least one derived page under wiki/ cites the exact image RAW and cache check for that RAW reports hit: true
The terminal response reports both image RAW capture and wiki synthesis without asking the user to repeat the organize request
